title: College Basketball
description:
Detroit Mercy at Michigan State
The No. 2 Michigan State Spartans host the Detroit Mercy Titans at Breslin Center in a basketball game. Michigan State broke a four-game win streak with a 61-46 loss against Tennessee, while Detroit Mercy searches for their first win this season.

title: B1G Countdown to Kickoff
description: Countdown to Kickoff takes you on the field leading up to game time with previews of the day's biggest games, plus the latest news from reporters across the country.

title: College Football
description:
Iowa at Illinois
The Illinois Fighting Illini (6-4) host the No. 15 Iowa Hawkeyes (8-2) at Gies Memorial Stadium in an FBS Big Ten game. Iowa aims for a fourth straight win behind Hank Brown, while Illinois broke a four-game win streak with a 22-14 loss against UCLA.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Maryland at USC
The No. 18 USC Trojans host the Maryland Terrapins at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in an NCAA football game. USC enters with alternate win-loss records in their last four games and looks for momentum, while Maryland aims for a three-game win streak.
